name: Quick View
summary: Canonical Modal profile over one complete target-coordinated product snapshot, composing full rich-media Product Gallery in no-detail mode, target-formatted Price, optional native Product Form, and an optional coherent full-details Link.

anatomy.description: Canonical Modal overlay while the target presents Quick View.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Canonical Modal dialog root with the Quick View domain profile.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Canonical Modal header containing the product title and visible close action.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required visible product title that also supplies the dialog accessible name.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Required named Modal dismiss action composed with canonical Close Button.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Scrollable canonical Modal body containing the product composition.

anatomy.name: layout
anatomy.description: Private container-responsive Gallery and information layout.

anatomy.name: gallery
anatomy.description: Required wrapper containing one canonical Product Gallery with the complete coordinated rich-media collection and imageDetail none.

anatomy.name: info
anatomy.description: Product decision information and continuation region.

anatomy.name: price
anatomy.description: Required wrapper containing one canonical target-formatted Price.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Optional canonical native Product Form composition.

anatomy.name: fullLink
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Link to the complete product detail destination.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One focused product quick-view Modal profile.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic container-responsive modal profile; geometry remains private.

states.name: closed
states.description: Target-hidden or unmounted Quick View; its descendants are unavailable.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible modal state with complete target modality and focus lifecycle.

states.name: withProductForm
states.description: Purchase continuation supplied by canonical Product Form.

states.name: withFullLink
states.description: Navigation continuation supplied by a coherent canonical Link with its inherited focus state.

states.name: richMedia
states.description: Within the required Gallery slot, the complete snapshot may include images, hosted video, external video, and models through canonical Product Gallery.

behavior.name: modalComposition
behavior.description: Quick View consumes the complete canonical Modal anatomy; the non-empty product title supplies its visible accessible name and a named close action remains present.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: Targets expose the open surface and keep closed content unavailable rather than leaving a hidden interactive subtree.

behavior.name: focusAndDismissal
behavior.description: The Modal dependency and target move focus appropriately, contain it while modal, support Escape and the visible close action, apply target backdrop policy, and restore focus logically.

behavior.name: galleryComposition
behavior.description: The required Gallery slot contains one canonical Product Gallery with the complete coordinated image/video/external-video/model collection and imageDetail none; K8 does not duplicate media selection, alternatives, activation, release, swipe, or current-state behavior.

behavior.name: noNestedImageDetail
behavior.description: Images remain passive inside the already-modal Quick View. K8 creates no nested, transferred, or emulated Lightbox; the complete-product destination uses Product Gallery's independent lightbox default.

behavior.name: priceComposition
behavior.description: The required Price slot contains one canonical Price supplied with complete target-formatted content; K8 performs no money parsing or formatting.

behavior.name: productFormComposition
behavior.description: When present, the Product Form slot is the real canonical native form and owns its child controls and action states; K8 does not duplicate purchase markup.

behavior.name: continuationCoherence
behavior.description: A valid Quick View provides Product Form, a complete Link label/destination pair, or both. One-sided Link values and synthetic fallback URLs are invalid.

behavior.name: targetCoordination
behavior.description: One target product coordinator opens K8 only from a complete coherent snapshot and synchronizes identity, rich media/current id, selected options, merchandise id, availability, Price, quantity rules, URL, inventory, pending/result/error state, cart refresh and one localized status. Incomplete, loading, or stale snapshots omit K8.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: The stable source order responds to the Quick View container, wraps localized and unbroken content, and avoids viewport-dependent internal composition.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty visible localized product title and dialog accessible name.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Contextual localized accessible name for the visible close action.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the target presents Quick View; complete modality and lifecycle remain target-owned.

properties.name: gallery
properties.description: Required slot containing one canonical Product Gallery supplied with the complete coordinated rich-media collection and imageDetail none.

properties.name: price
properties.description: Required slot containing one canonical target-formatted Price.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Optional concise target-authored product excerpt; K8 does not visually clamp a longer hidden value.

properties.name: productForm
properties.description: Optional canonical native Product Form composition.

properties.name: fullLinkLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete Link unless href is also non-empty.

properties.name: href
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete Link unless fullLinkLabel is also non-empty; never invent a fallback destination.

accessibility: Compose the complete Modal dependency and assert aria-modal=true only when outside content is genuinely inert and focus is contained.
Use the required visible non-empty product title through aria-labelledby and always provide a visible close action with a contextual accessible name.
Choose content-aware initial focus, contain Tab and Shift+Tab, close on Escape, and restore focus to the invoker or another logical workflow target.

Preserve Product Gallery alternative text, named selection controls, swipe, explicit rich-media activation/release, native target fallbacks and current-media status without creating a second gallery keyboard model.
Keep imageDetail none inside the already-modal Quick View so featured images are passive and no nested or transferred Lightbox/dialog can open.
Render one canonical target-formatted Price and keep price/availability changes out of independent duplicate live regions.
Render optional Product Form as a real native form with canonical child controls; target confirmation, error, retry, focus and announcement timing remain target-owned.
Render the full-details destination as a native canonical Link only when both descriptive label and real href exist.
Honor reduced motion, preserve forced-color boundaries, logical direction and effective 200 percent reflow without horizontal overflow.

web.notes: Canonical composition and container layout are implemented in source CSS. Web targets map complete modality through native dialog or an equivalent proven lifecycle without neutral Quick View runtime.

shopify.notes: The product-context snippet maps complete product.media through canonical Product Gallery with image_detail none plus canonical Price/Form/Link. Invocation, complete-snapshot loading, variant synchronization, purchase lifecycle, focus/status and live-theme proof remain target work.

react.notes: Framework adapter may expose controlled/uncontrolled open state while one parent product coordinator owns the complete snapshot, Gallery current id, Price, Product Form, URL and result synchronization.
